_comment: Which paths ship in a release, and who owns each one after install. managed = the release owns it (replaced on upgrade, verified by readback). seed = written once if absent, then yours forever. Anything excluded never ships; anything you create yourself is invisible to the installer. client_owned = paths that are the client's by contract and never part of any package (the settings override layer): the installer never writes, replaces, verifies or removes them, and a release build refuses a source that tracks one. seed_lines = declared lines a release adds once to a seed file that predates them (the operator core's import, and since 3.0 the folder map's import, in CLAUDE.md); never twice, never into a deleted file, taken back by rollback. layout = the 3.0 folder move (see its own comment).

render.why: CODEOWNERS must name owners who actually have access to THIS repository, so it is rendered per workspace, never copied.

layout._comment: Starter 3.0 instance layout. On upgrade from layout 2, every file under a retired folder that the installed release doesn't manage moves to its new folder: a hard link, then the old name removed, so bytes, size and mode never change. Longest matching 'from' wins; every retired folder has a catch-all. Planned and journaled before the first move; refused, changing nothing, on any existing destination, case or Unicode collision, symlink, nested repository or other disk. The quarantine names are set aside in the upgrade's backup, not moved. A website folder moves only after Vercel confirms no project still builds the old path.
